evidence.locator: Current response bound to the immediately preceding proposal

context.narrative_job: Expose a specific operating decision that depends on the owner while keeping the existing business recognizable.
context.viewer_before: The business and its tangible assets remain; why the owner is essential has not been visually established.

data.choice: Fourteen-second fixed model view using accepted workshop and compact figure. Owner selects Use on a Material change sheet; resolved sheet returns to the workshop. Owner leaves; Customer exception sheet arrives at the same desk with Allow/Hold blank.
data.reason: A named unresolved choice makes the owner contribution more legible than tiny hardware pantomime, while exact reused drawing sources preserve continuity.

reuse.applies_when: A current dependency can be illustrated by one explicitly unanswered operating choice.
reuse.avoid_when: It would falsely imply all operations stop, routine delegable approval proves unique knowledge, or labels merely repeat narration.

animation.form: Persistent illustrated business and owner decision station
